title: The monitoring of emergent zoonotic pathogens in wild and captive birds in Sarajevo Canton, Bosnia and Herzegovina
author: Adis Softić
license_note: figshare article detail endpoint license.name: CC BY 4.0

steps.title: Collect bird samples
steps.instruction: Collect a total of 358 samples from fifteen bird species at 21 locations in Sarajevo Canton over the three years 2022–2024.

steps.title: Detect Chlamydia by qPCR
steps.instruction: Subject the collected samples to real‑time PCR (qPCR) assays for Chlamydia spp. and specifically C. psittaci, following the established protocols referenced in the study.

steps.title: Detect viral pathogens by RT‑qPCR
steps.instruction: Use reverse‑transcriptase real‑time PCR (RT‑qPCR) on the same samples to test for avian influenza viruses, Chikungunya virus, Usutu virus, and West Nile virus.
